description: This file defines the AuditContext struct and related functions for managing audit event data and context within the Kubernetes API server, including context handling, event logging, and annotations.

classes.name: AuditContext
classes.description: Holds audit event data and configuration for the current request, including methods for event logging, annotations, and context management.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if auditing is enabled for this context.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the AuditContext with configuration and sink.

methods.name: AuditID
methods.description: Returns the unguarded audit ID.

methods.name: visitEvent
methods.description: Executes a function with a reference to the audit event, with thread safety.

methods.name: ProcessEventStage
methods.description: Processes a specific stage of the audit event, returning success status.

methods.name: LogImpersonatedUser
methods.description: Logs impersonated user info into the audit event.

methods.name: LogResponseObject
methods.description: Logs response status and object into the audit event.

methods.name: LogRequestPatch
methods.description: Logs request patch data into the audit event.

methods.name: GetEventUser
methods.description: Returns a copy of the user info associated with the event.

methods.name: GetEventImpersonatedUser
methods.description: Returns a copy of the impersonated user info, if any.

methods.name: GetEventAnnotation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific annotation from the event.

methods.name: GetEventLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of the audit event.

methods.name: SetEventStage
methods.description: Sets the stage of the audit event.

methods.name: GetEventStage
methods.description: Retrieves the current stage of the audit event.

methods.name: SetEventStageTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for the current stage.

methods.name: GetEventResponseStatus
methods.description: Returns the response status of the event.

methods.name: GetEventRequestReceivedTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the request was received.

methods.name: GetEventStageTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the current event stage.

methods.name: SetEventResponseStatus
methods.description: Sets the response status of the event.

methods.name: SetEventResponseStatusCode
methods.description: Sets the response status code.

methods.name: GetEventAnnotations
methods.description: Returns a copy of all annotations.

methods.name: AddAuditAnnotation
methods.description: Adds a key-value annotation to the event.

methods.name: AddAuditAnnotations
methods.description: Adds multiple key-value annotations.

methods.name: AddAuditAnnotationsMap
methods.description: Adds annotations from a map.

methods.name: WithAuditContext
methods.description: Creates a new context with an AuditContext.

methods.name: AuditContextFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the AuditContext from a context.

methods.name: WithAuditID
methods.description: Sets the audit ID in the context's AuditContext.

methods.name: AuditIDFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the audit ID from the context.

methods.name: GetAuditIDTruncated
methods.description: Returns a truncated version of the audit ID for logging.
